parameters.help_en: The backend product code that identifies the product to which the request belongs. Use the default value defined in the current API, which must be consistent with the product to which the instance belongs. The visibility and default value of this field remain unchanged. Do not use the POP product name directly as the backend product code. The current POP default value is OUTBOUND_BOT
parameters.help_zh: 标识请求所属产品的后端产品代码。应使用当前API定义的默认值，与实例所属产品一致；该字段的可见性和默认值保持原样，不要将POP产品名称直接当作后端产品代码。 当前POP定义默认值为OUTBOUND_BOT
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The visitor token obtained from the trial link. It is used to locate the trial channel and verify access permissions and the validity period. The token is generated by the channel service and must not be constructed manually. It cannot be empty and must be within its validity period. The example is a placeholder value that cannot be used for authentication. Do not disclose actual tokens to unauthorized personnel
parameters.help_zh: 从体验链接取得的访客令牌，用于定位试用渠道并校验访问权限和有效期。令牌由渠道服务生成，不应自行构造；不能为空，且必须仍在有效期内。示例为不可用于认证的占位值，请勿将真实令牌泄露给无关人员
parameters.name: visitor_token

schema.description_en: The business response for this API. A Code value of OK indicates success, and Data contains the corresponding business result. For business errors, troubleshoot by combining Message and Params
schema.description_zh: 本次API的业务响应，Code=OK表示成功，Data为对应业务结果；业务错误结合Message及Params排查

Code.description_en: The business processing status code. A value of OK indicates success. When an exception occurs, the corresponding business error code is returned. The error types and mapping rules follow the current API configuration. No error codes are added or modified in this update
Code.description_zh: 业务处理状态码，OK表示成功；发生异常时返回对应的业务错误码。错误类型和映射规则沿用当前API配置，本次不新增或修改错误码

Data.description_en: The channel configuration corresponding to the VisitorToken and its associated scenarios, used for trial page initialization
Data.description_zh: VisitorToken对应的渠道配置及其关联场景，用于体验页面初始化

AccessChannelId.description_en: The ID of the channel associated with the trial link or specific access configuration. When a channel needs to be associated, use the ID actually returned by the channel service. It is not the ChannelId returned by a call, and the two must not be mixed. The configuration layer uses a UUID as the channel ID when creating a new channel
AccessChannelId.description_zh: 关联体验链接或具体接入配置的渠道标识。需要关联渠道时使用渠道服务实际返回的标识；不是呼叫返回的ChannelId，两者不可混用。配置层新建渠道使用UUID作为渠道标识

AccessChannelType.description_en: Identifies the access source of the current interaction. The configuration layer enumerations are TEST (voice test window or real number outbound call test), TEXT_TEST (text test window), TRIAL (web voice trial link), and TEXT_TRIAL (text trial link). The existing default values and visibility of each API remain unchanged. If the current definition uses the historical value Text, it should be processed according to the existing definition and is not modified in this documentation update
AccessChannelType.description_zh: 标识当前交互的接入来源。配置层枚举为TEST（语音测试窗或真实号码外呼测试）、TEXT_TEST（文本测试窗）、TRIAL（网页语音体验链接）、TEXT_TRIAL（文本体验链接）。各API既有默认值和可见性保持不变；如当前定义使用历史值Text，应按现有定义处理，不在本次文档补充中修改

BuilderType.description_en: The scenario building method. The configuration layer enumerations are FLOW and LITE. This field is not declared in the current business layer channel response object. Therefore, whether it is actually returned depends on the deployment version
BuilderType.description_zh: 场景构建方式，配置层枚举为FLOW和LITE。当前业务层渠道响应对象未声明此字段，因此是否实际返回需核实部署版本

ChannelScripts.description_en: The scenarios associated with this channel and their display, variable, and label configurations. The trial page should use the ScriptId actually returned in the list and must not specify scenarios outside the channel
ChannelScripts.description_zh: 此渠道关联的场景及其展示、变量和标签配置。体验页面应使用列表中实际返回的ScriptId，不应自行指定渠道之外的场景

items.description_en: The ID, name, and variable/label configurations exported from the scenario version for an available trial scenario
items.description_zh: 一个可体验场景的标识、名称和场景版本导出的变量/标签配置

LabelConfigs.description_en: The JSON string of the label configuration exported from the scenario version. The specific fields are determined by the scenario version. The empty JSON array in the example only indicates that there are no configuration items and must not be confused with the call parameter Tags
LabelConfigs.description_zh: 场景版本导出的标签配置JSON字符串。具体字段由场景版本决定；示例空JSON数组只表示无配置项，不应与呼叫参数Tags混淆

ScriptId.description_en: The ID of the dialog scenario under the instance. Specify an existing scenario. Subsequent dialogs and end requests for the same text session should use the scenario specified when the session is started
ScriptId.description_zh: 实例下的对话场景标识。请填写实际存在的场景；同一文本会话的后续对话和结束请求应使用开启会话时的场景

ScriptName.description_en: The name of the scenario associated with the channel, used for display on the trial page. Use the actual value returned by the service
ScriptName.description_zh: 渠道关联场景的名称，用于体验页面展示，使用服务实际返回值

VariableConfigs.description_en: The JSON string of the variable configuration exported from the scenario version. It is not the variable values passed in this interaction. The specific configuration items are determined by the scenario version. The empty JSON array in the example only indicates that there are no configuration items and does not declare unverified internal fields
VariableConfigs.description_zh: 场景版本导出的变量配置JSON字符串，不是本次交互传入的变量取值。具体配置项由场景版本决定；示例空JSON数组只表示无配置项，不声明未核实的内部字段

ChannelSetting.description_en: The display configuration of the trial channel, which is a JSON object string. The content is configured during channel creation and agreed upon with the trial page, and may include display information such as Images. The current code does not provide a complete fixed structure, and the empty object in the example only illustrates the serialization format
ChannelSetting.description_zh: 体验渠道展示配置，为JSON对象字符串。内容由渠道创建时配置和体验页面约定，可能包含Images等展示信息；当前代码未给出完整固定结构，示例空对象仅说明序列化格式

CreatedTime.description_en: The creation time of the channel, in Unix timestamp format and measured in milliseconds. It is converted from the creation time of the configuration layer entity
CreatedTime.description_zh: 渠道创建时间，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，由配置层实体创建时间转换得到

ExpirationTime.description_en: The expiration time of the trial channel and the visitor token, in Unix timestamp format and measured in milliseconds. The service compares the validity period with the current system time in milliseconds. Expired tokens cannot continue the trial
ExpirationTime.description_zh: 体验渠道及访客令牌的有效期截止时间，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒。服务以当前系统毫秒时间比较有效期，过期令牌无法继续试用

InstanceId.description_en: The instance identity of the product to which it belongs. You must use an instance that the invoker has permission to access and that actually exists. It must be consistent with the instance to which the scenario, channel, and session belong. The maximum length is subject to the current POP parameter definition
InstanceId.description_zh: 所属产品的实例标识。必须使用调用者有权访问且确实存在的实例；应与场景、渠道和会话所属实例保持一致。最大长度以当前POP参数定义为准

Name.description_en: The name of the trial channel, used for display and identification on the trial page. The content is configured by the channel creator
Name.description_zh: 体验渠道的名称，用于体验页面展示和识别，内容由渠道创建者配置

NluEngine.description_en: The natural language understanding (NLU) engine type defined in the configuration layer. Valid values: BEEBOT, PROMPTS, and FUNCTION. This field is not declared in the current business layer channel response object. Therefore, whether it can be returned through this operation depends on the deployment version and must not be assumed to always exist on the client
NluEngine.description_zh: 配置层定义的语义理解引擎类型，包括BEEBOT、PROMPTS和FUNCTION。当前业务层渠道响应对象未声明此字段，因此是否能通过本接口返回需核实部署版本，不能在客户端假设必定存在

State.description_en: The channel status. Valid values: Active (effective) and Expired (invalid). Trial access still requires server-side token and validity period verification. You cannot bypass the verification based solely on the status value saved on the client
State.description_zh: 渠道状态：Active表示生效中，Expired表示失效。试用访问仍需要通过服务端令牌和有效期校验，不能仅根据客户端保存的状态值绕过校验

UpdatedTime.description_en: The last update time of the channel, in Unix timestamp format and measured in milliseconds. It is converted from the update time of the configuration layer entity
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 渠道最近修改时间，Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，由配置层实体修改时间转换得到

VisitorToken.description_en: The visitor token obtained from the trial link. It is used to locate the trial channel and verify access permissions and the validity period. The token is generated by the channel service and must not be constructed manually. It cannot be empty and must be within its validity period. The example is a placeholder value that cannot be used for authentication. Do not disclose actual tokens to unauthorized personnel
VisitorToken.description_zh: 从体验链接取得的访客令牌，用于定位试用渠道并校验访问权限和有效期。令牌由渠道服务生成，不应自行构造；不能为空，且必须仍在有效期内。示例为不可用于认证的占位值，请勿将真实令牌泄露给无关人员

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code recorded in the business response body. A normal return value is 200. To determine whether the business operation is successful, you must also check the Code field. The presence of this field alone does not indicate a successful call
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 业务响应体记录的HTTP状态码，正常返回为200。判断业务是否成功还应检查Code，不能仅凭该字段存在认定调用成功

Message.description_en: The business response or error description. It is usually empty or not returned upon success, and a fixed text cannot be required for successful responses. Upon failure, it provides an error description to assist in troubleshooting. Combine it with Code and Params to understand the cause of the error. The example shows an error message when the trial link visitor token expires (corresponding to the Code Expired.VisitorToken) and is for format reference only
Message.description_zh: 业务响应或错误说明。成功时通常为空或不返回，不能要求成功时固定返回某段文本；失败时为错误说明，用于辅助排查，并结合Code与Params理解错误原因。示例为体验链接访客令牌过期时的错误消息（对应Code为Expired.VisitorToken），仅作格式参考

RequestId.description_en: The ID used to associate and troubleshoot this POP request. The value in the response corresponds to the current request. System request parameters are injected by the gateway, and callers do not need to fill in system fields manually
RequestId.description_zh: 用于关联和排查本次POP请求的标识。响应中的值对应本次请求；系统请求参数由网关注入，调用者不需要自行填写系统字段

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the business processing is successful. A value of true indicates success, and false indicates failure. The current general response implementation determines success based on whether the Code is OK
Success.description_zh: 业务处理是否成功，true表示成功，false表示失败。当前通用响应实现按Code是否为OK判断成功
